Chat max_tokens caps generation; input plus generated length is limited by model context length.
Response usage splits prompt cache hit/miss and completion; length finish can indicate output or context limit.
Responses guide states oversized context returns 400 and truncation is unsupported. This is not a Chat guarantee.
Billing is based on total model input and output token usage and prices; gift deducted before topped-up balance. Prices may change.
Documented balance_infos array includes currency CNY or USD and decimal-string total/granted/topped-up amounts.
Character ratios are estimates; actual usage is returned. Linked tokenizer does not establish online full-request billing equivalence.
